body:
It is the spec's own shape: one flat JSON document per event, a type
tag, and per-type required fields — the §2.1 table is literally the
validate() table. The flatness is also what lets unknown event types
round-trip: Other(kind) + extra can carry any future event unchanged (a
§2.1 MUST), which an enum-per-kind can't do without a catch-all variant
that reintroduces the same optionals. A typed enum view layered on top
for ergonomics is doable if the field count keeps growing, though —
happy to sketch it.
